around.headline: Bengaluru-bound train passenger alleges TTE collected excess fare via a personal UPI ID; probe opens a month later
around.summary: A passenger says a ticket examiner asked for extra fare to be paid to his personal UPI handle instead of issuing an official receipt, and it took a month for a probe to begin. Only pay railway staff through the official handheld-machine receipt or counter — a personal UPI request from anyone in uniform is a red flag.

around.headline: Bengaluru woman alleges Rs 2.5 crore fraud by a self-styled godman
around.summary: A woman has filed a case alleging a self-styled godman defrauded her of Rs 2.5 crore, reportedly through promises tied to spiritual guidance. Be wary of anyone — however credible they seem — who asks for large sums in exchange for guarantees about your future or finances.

around.headline: Bengaluru's 'Pickup Squad' has booked 3,500 anti-social elements over the past three months
around.summary: City police say their Pickup Squad initiative has picked up and booked 3,500 anti-social elements in three months as part of an ongoing crackdown. If you notice suspicious loitering or harassment in your area, this is an active channel worth flagging to local police.

around.headline: Cauvery row escalates: Tamil Nadu moves Supreme Court as Karnataka minister says there's 'no point' releasing water amid its own shortage
around.summary: After Karnataka's CM asked Tamil Nadu's CM to defer a Bengaluru visit, Tamil Nadu has decided to approach the Supreme Court, while a Union minister argued Karnataka shouldn't release water it doesn't have to spare. Keep an eye on news over the next few days — further protests or a bandh could affect travel and deliveries in and around the city.

around.headline: Garbage collection reverts to BBMP corporations; Lokayukta sets Aug 15 deadline to clear black spots, DKS warns property owners
around.summary: Bengaluru's waste collection is moving back under direct corporation control after an earlier contracting model, with the Lokayukta giving civic authorities until August 15 to clear garbage black spots, and the CM warning property owners to keep their sites clean or face action. If you own an empty plot, get it cleared before mid-August to avoid a notice or fine.

around.headline: Karnataka bans sale of junk food in and around schools and colleges
around.summary: The state government has ordered a ban on junk food sales in and near educational institutions, part of a push against poor nutrition among students. Parents can expect canteens and nearby vendors to start pulling packaged snacks and sugary drinks in the coming weeks.

street_smart.title: A ticket examiner on your Bengaluru-bound train says you owe excess fare or a seat upgrade charge, and instead of the handheld machine, he asks you to just pay it to his personal UPI ID. What do you do?
street_smart.based_on: Real incident in today's news: a passenger alleges a TTE collected fare via a personal UPI handle, and a probe into it only began a month later (The Times of India).
street_smart.situation: You're still on the train, the TTE is standing right there, and you have your phone out. This is the only moment you can insist on doing this the right way — once he moves down the coach, there's no record left to point to.

choices.text: Ask him to process the payment on his official handheld ticketing machine and give you a printed receipt — that's the only valid way excess fare or upgrades are supposed to be collected.
choices.feedback: Correct. Every legitimate on-board fare transaction goes through the railway's own machine and generates a receipt with a transaction number. If a staff member skips that and asks for money on a personal account, it isn't going to the railways — and without a receipt, you have no proof you ever paid.

choices.text: Pay to his personal UPI ID since he's in uniform and seems to know what he's doing, and figure the receipt isn't a big deal.
choices.feedback: This is the trap. A uniform doesn't make a personal UPI request legitimate — as in today's case, it took a month for anyone to even start looking into it, and by then you'd have no receipt, no transaction proof, and no way to show the fare was ever officially recorded.

choices.text: Pay him in cash instead, without asking for any receipt, assuming cash is safer than UPI.
choices.feedback: Cash without a receipt has the exact same problem as UPI to a personal account — there's no official record either way. The payment method isn't the issue; the missing machine-generated receipt is.

choices.text: Refuse to pay anything at all and demand he leave, even if the excess fare charge might be genuine.
choices.feedback: Outright refusal can backfire if the charge is actually valid — you may end up escalated to the next stop or fined more. Ask him to run it through the official machine instead of refusing outright; a genuine TTE will do this without hesitation.

takeaways: Legitimate excess-fare or upgrade charges on Indian Railways are collected through the TTE's handheld machine and come with a printed receipt — a request to pay a personal UPI ID or personal account is a red flag regardless of uniform.
If a receipt isn't offered, ask for one before paying anything — it's the only proof the payment was official, and a genuine railway employee won't object to giving one.
You can report a suspected fare scam to the Railway Protection Force helpline (139) with the coach and PNR details, even if you only realize something was off after the fact.

quiz.question: After Karnataka's CM asked Tamil Nadu's CM to defer a Bengaluru visit amid the Cauvery water row, what did Tamil Nadu decide to do?
quiz.why: Cauvery water-sharing disputes between Karnataka and Tamil Nadu are usually adjudicated through the Cauvery Water Management Authority or the courts, since the two states have never fully agreed on a sharing formula outside binding rulings.

quiz.question: Karnataka's government has ordered a ban on the sale of junk food in and around which type of institutions?
quiz.why: Several Indian states have introduced similar restrictions near schools in recent years, following FSSAI guidance aimed at curbing early exposure to high-sugar, high-fat packaged foods.

quiz.question: Bengaluru's garbage collection is reverting to direct control by which civic body, after an earlier contracting experiment?
quiz.why: The Lokayukta has separately set an August 15 deadline for civic authorities to clear the city's remaining garbage 'black spots.'

quiz.question: What is the minimum number of judges required to constitute a Constitution Bench of the Supreme Court of India?
quiz.why: Constitution Benches are formed to decide cases involving substantial questions of law about interpreting the Constitution, as required under Article 145(3).

quiz.question: Which vitamin does the human body synthesize in the skin when exposed to sunlight?
quiz.why: Vitamin D synthesis needs UVB rays, which is why people who stay mostly indoors or use heavy sunscreen year-round are more prone to deficiency even in sunny cities.
